items.name: ask
items.title: Ask
items.description: A question for a person with stacked choices, keyboard shortcuts and an optional tray, built on @outfitter/parks.
items.docs: Import @outfitter/parks/styles.css once from your root stylesheet before using Parks blocks.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: A bordered frame for code or a diff with a label and copy button, and a highlighted snippet on Pierre's renderer, themed by Parks roles.
items.docs: Import @outfitter/parks/styles.css once from your root stylesheet before using Parks blocks.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The app frame: a sidebar that docks on wide frames and opens as a modal over the page on narrow ones, a page bar and a sidebar toggle, in inset (web) or floating (Apple) style.
items.docs: Import @outfitter/parks/styles.css once from your root stylesheet before using Parks blocks.

items.name: ask-queue
items.title: Ask queue
items.description: A queue of questions waiting on a person: the list beside the open ask, or two screens with progress on narrow containers; choice asks via the Ask block, written replies otherwise; Open and Answered views.
items.docs: Import @outfitter/parks/styles.css once from your root stylesheet before using Parks blocks.
